suppress.notes: False positives caused by a broad CPE match. Both CVEs affect HttpComponents Core 5 (httpcore5/httpcore5-h2), not the HttpCore 4 artifact matched here.

Temporary, version-specific suppression pending adoption of Jackson 2.21.5. The vulnerable combination of per-property JsonIgnoreProperties and ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES is not used by this application.

Temporary, version-specific suppression pending adoption of Log4j 2.25.5. Log4j API is present only through the SLF4J-to-Logback bridge; this application does not use MapMessage JSON serialization or JsonTemplateLayout.

Temporary, version-specific suppressions pending adoption of Tomcat 11.0.24. The application does not configure the affected FFM connector, RewriteValve, EncryptInterceptor, default-servlet web.xml constraints, or bundled examples. CVE-2026-55276 concerns diagnostic logging of effective web.xml only.
